copy.curiosityHook: As an appraiser pieces together its path across Austria, England, and China, what dark secret from its 1681 creation left a trail of misfortune?
copy.description: Crafted in 1681 by Italian master Bussotti, a singular red violin crosses continents over three centuries. In modern Montreal, an appraiser examines the storied instrument ahead of auction, unearthing its fraught past.
copy.vibeSummary: Thoughtful, suspenseful, and emotionally heavy; a sweeping multi-language drama suited for patient, attentive viewing.
copy.whyWatch: Director François Girard frames an ambitious, multi-era drama around one instrument, weaving romance and mystery into a rich tapestry marked by artistic passion and quiet tragedy.

allowedMaterial: Crafting of the violin by Bussotti in 1681 Italy
Journey across Austria, England, China, and Canada leaving beauty and tragedy
Montreal auction appraisal investigation led by Samuel L. Jackson's character
Multi-century, multi-language mystery and romance framework
excludedMaterial: Specific origin and composition of the violin's red varnish
Outcomes of the Montreal auction and modern theft plot
Fate of individual historical owners across the vignettes
